headline: Held public hearings on bonds for $5,173,428 in equipment, including plow trucks, a $3 million library renovation design, and a $9 million ERP system.
summary: Hearings also covered bonds for a fire training facility, a Pine Hill fire station design, and fire station repairs. Library supporters spoke in favor, while one resident opposed all the bonds over public records and borrowing costs. Aldermen asked about interest costs and whether leasing was an option for vehicles.
